evidence_basis: Hong reports DecodingTrust preservation at 4-bit; our HarmBench INT4 evaluation shows -11pp degradation on harder benchmark, motivating expert recommendation to evaluate post-quant rather than assuming safe.
Hong reports significant degradation below 4-bit; CAQ and Q-resafe target this regime per source papers.
Qi shows safety removal via 100 benign examples; Safe LoRA is the targeted countermeasure.
Source papers explicitly report rank-1 LoRA suffices for safety alignment up to 7B.
Aggregated from corpus reports of distillation amplifying English-centric safety; concrete multilingual KD safety validation is scarce in the corpus, hence the recommendation is expert synthesis.
Both source papers report safety preservation or improvement up to ~20% pruning with WANDA; degradation above this threshold is reported.
NSPO is a 2026 preprint; its central claim has not been independently replicated; we therefore mark both columns as expert synthesis pending replication.
